summary: This dataset consists of 71 OCTA images of the superficial capillary plexus from 10 patients, captured using the Topcon DRI OCT Triton device, covering an area of 6x6 mm with a resolution of 320x320 pixels. The images were obtained in a real-world clinical setting and may contain noise or motion artifacts. The dataset is used to evaluate a method for generating high-resolution wide-field OCTA mosaics from overlapping scans, which is implemented in the accompanying code repository.
